item_name: Rothco U.S. Coast Guard Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Proudly support your United States Coast Guard with Rothco’s U.S. Coast Guard Low Profile Insignia Cap.
description: Proudly support your United States Coast Guard with Rothco’s U.S. Coast Guard Low Profile Insignia Cap. “U.S. Coast Guard” text is embroidered into the front panel of this military support cap in stark gold thread while the U.S.C.G. emblem is embroidered on the low-profile cap’s front panel with impeccable detailing. This tactical hat features an adjustable hook & loop closure back for a custom, snug fit, and a padded sweatband is integrated into this military insignia cap for all day wear. This Coast Guard hat is constructed with a 100% brushed cotton twill material for rugged durability without sacrificing comfort.
